Friedrich Dürrenmatt's works that are considered crime novels include:

1. **"Der Richter und sein Henker" (The Judge and His Hangman)**
2. **"Der Kommissar" (The Commissioner)**
3. **"Der Besuch des alten Tünnes" (The Visit of the Old Tünnes)**

These novels often blend elements of crime fiction with philosophical, existential, and absurdist themes, characteristic of Dürrenmatt's style.
